items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Arthur Gibb was on piano. We had ten pieces.

ctx.x: Oh, he was a pretty trombone player.
Yeah, we had Gene Michael on alto. His brother (Unintelligible) was on third alto, and I was on tenor, and Billy Taylor was on bass. Arthur Gibb was on piano. We had ten pieces.
